# Philippa Gordon

## Overview

- **Age:** 18 years old  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Phil  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Philippa is noted for her vivid and bewitching prettiness, featuring brown velvety eyes under oddly-pointed black brows, rose-red crooked lips, and satin-smooth hair with a gloss of brown nuts. She has round cheeks with a soft, ripe glow and pays close attention to her stylish attire, such as modish shoes and smart hats.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020)_

## Personality

Philippa is lively, talkative, and highly social, often surrounded by male admirers. She admits to being plagued by chronic indecision and an inability to keep secrets. Despite her initial insistence on frivolity and marrying for wealth, she is a loyal, generous friend who possesses sharp intelligence when she applies herself.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c4 P26](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0026), [v3 c4 P36](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0036), [v3 c4 P52](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0052)_

## History

Philippa Gordon was born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia, to a prominent and wealthy family. Upon arriving at Redmond College, she quickly became a central figure in social life due to her background, beauty, and charming personality. She first met Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant in an old graveyard near campus, instantly deciding to become close friends with them. Throughout her first year at Redmond, she introduced Anne and Priscilla to her wide circle of friends and social gatherings. She regularly shared tales of her numerous suitors, particularly her two primary hometown admirers, Alec and Alonzo, whom she struggled to choose between. Over time, she moved into Patty's Place with Anne, Priscilla, and Aunt Jamesina. Eventually, Philippa abandoned her superficial romantic criteria and chose to marry Jonas 'Jo' Blake.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 c4 P24](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0024), [v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c4 P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054), [v3 c19 P30](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0030)_
